1	import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest'
2	import { parse } from '../src/parse'
3	
4	describe('parse', () => {
5	  it('parses a single row of comma-separated fields', () => {
6	    expect(parse('a,b,c')).toEqual([['a', 'b', 'c']])
7	  })
8	
9	  it('parses multiple rows separated by newlines', () => {
10	    expect(parse('a,b,c\n1,2,3')).toEqual([
11	      ['a', 'b', 'c'],
12	      ['1', '2', '3'],
13	    ])
14	  })
15	
16	  it('treats commas inside quoted fields as literal characters', () => {
17	    expect(parse('name,quote\nAlice,"hello, world"')).toEqual([
18	      ['name', 'quote'],
19	      ['Alice', 'hello, world'],
20	    ])
21	  })
22	
23	  it('treats two consecutive double quotes inside a quoted field as a literal quote', () => {
24	    expect(parse('id,note\n1,"she said ""hi"""')).toEqual([
25	      ['id', 'note'],
26	      ['1', 'she said "hi"'],
27	    ])
28	  })
29	
30	  it('preserves newlines inside a quoted field without terminating the row', () => {
31	    expect(parse('id,bio\n1,"line one\nline two"')).toEqual([
32	      ['id', 'bio'],
33	      ['1', 'line one\nline two'],
34	    ])
35	  })
36	})
